title: Additional Rental Day Charge on Returned Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Contracts
content:
**Billing desk reference — the additional rental day charge of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental.** When a contract is checked in, the rental days it ran beyond its opening day, within the rental days it was booked for, are charged on the contract as an additional rental day charge. The charge is booked as a base rental fee line on the contract, and the renter sees it on the final invoice.

## What the posting does

`post_additional_rental_day_charge_add5e32c` adds one base rental fee line to the contract for the amount given, carrying the number of additional rental days as its quantity and the service date given, and the amount owed on the contract rises by that amount.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number the charge belongs to, read from the truck rental lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the renter on that contract, read from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `service_date` | The date the additional-day line relates to | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `additional_days` | The number of rental days started beyond the opening day | Whole integer count |
| `amount` | The additional-day charge in USD | Positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "posted", `truck_charge_id` (the id of the new charge line), `truck_rental_id`, `charge_type` "base_rental_fee", `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `quantity` (the additional days, integer), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the contract, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "posted" means the line is on the contract.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Called with `additional_days` 2, `service_date` 2026-05-06 and `amount` 49.90, the tool returns `status` "posted" with `quantity` 2 and a `balance_due` 49.90 higher than before.
